% amsmath's thin space after dots: after \cdots and \dots before a right
% delimiter, after \cdots, \dotsb, \dotso, and \dotsc before a semicolon or
% period, after \cdots also before a comma, and at the end of an inline
% formula. None after \ldots, after \dots before a comma, a period, or a
% binary operator, after \cdots before a letter, or at the end of an
% argument.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\begin{document}
$(a+\cdots)$,
$(x_1,\dots)$,
$(\ldots)$,
$a+\cdots, b$,
$x_1,\dots, x_n$,
$\left(a+\cdots\right)$,
$\{a,\dotsc\}$,
$\langle a,\dotsb\rangle$,
$a,\dotsc;$,
$a,\dotso.$,
$a\cdots b$,
$a + \dots + b$,
$a,\dots.$,
$\bigl(a,\dots\bigr)$,
$\mathrm{a\cdots}b$,
$a+\cdots$.
\end{document}
